model_output:
Here is a simple macro that can be used in LibreOffice Calc to open a form from a button:

1. Open the Calc document that contains the form you want to open.
2. Click on the "Developer" tab in the toolbar.
3. In the "Macros" group, click on "Create New Macro".
4. Name the macro "Open Form" and click "OK".
5. In the macro editor, add the following code:
```
// This macro opens the "Form1" form

// Replace "Form1" with the name of your form

public function openForm()
{
    Dim formName As String
    formName = "Form1"
    
    If Not Application.ActiveDocument.Formats.ItemExists(formName) Then
        Application.FSError = 13
        return
    End If
    
    Application.ActiveDocument.Formats.Item(formName).Show
}
```
1. Save the macro and close the macro editor.
2. Click on the "View" tab in the toolbar and select "Toolbar Buttons".
3. Click on "New" to create a new toolbar button.
4. Select "Button" from the options and click "OK".
5. Select "openForm" from the list of available macros and click "OK".
6. Click on "Close" to close the "New Toolbar Button" dialog box.
7. You should now see a button on your toolbar that, when clicked, will open the form in your Calc document.

Note that this is just a basic example, you can customize the macro as per your requirements.
